summary: Completed both backend and frontend testing for Iteration 14 - USDA FDC API fixes and search/details features. All requested features working correctly: Food search returns calories_per_100g, Food details pages load for SR Legacy foods (169886, 174901), meal selector switching works, food row click navigates to details page.

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' - minor accessibility improvement
Console warning about chart width/height being -1 when charts initially render - cosmetic issue, charts render correctly
